topic: How does dual-band polarization independence affect Ka-band link budget margins for simultaneous uplink and downlink operations?
consensus_response: The introduction of dual-band polarization independence in Ka-band satellite communications significantly affects link budget margins due to increased atmospheric attenuation and polarization losses.
